title: HackNova 2026: 36-Hour National Hackathon
venue: APJ Abdul Kalam Auditorium & AI Labs
description: A premier 36-hour hackathon bringing together over 75 collegiate teams to tackle real-world industry challenges in Artificial Intelligence, sustainable tech, and distributed cloud computing.

title: International Conference on Next-Gen Web Technologies
description: Keynote presentations and interactive panel discussions with Google Developer Experts on WebAssembly, Edge Functions, React Server Components, and responsive design systems.

title: Hands-on Deep Learning & LLM Deployment Workshop
description: An intensive 4-hour hands-on workshop covering fine-tuning open-source LLMs, quantization with bitsandbytes, and building production-grade inference pipelines on GPUs.

title: Spandan 2026: Annual Cultural Fiesta & Gala Night
description: The flagship inter-college cultural celebration showcasing battle of bands, theatrical plays, classical dance performances, art showcases, and a live celebrity musical night.

title: Inter-Collegiate Cricket Championship 2026
description: An exhilarating 16-team knockout T20 cricket tournament featuring premier university squads competing for the prestigious Chancellor's Trophy.

title: Full-Stack System Design & Microservices Masterclass
description: Practical breakdown of high-throughput architectures, distributed caching, event-driven messaging with Apache Kafka, and database sharding patterns.

title: CyberDefense CTF: Ethical Hacking Challenge
description: Jeopardy-style Capture The Flag competition spanning reverse engineering, web application security vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10), forensics, and cryptography.

title: Annual Campus Placement & Career Odyssey Expo
description: Networking summit hosting HR directors and senior architects from 40+ leading tech MNCs and startups, featuring resume clinics, mock coding interviews, and career counseling.

title: DevOps, Kubernetes & Cloud Native Pipelines
description: Learn to containerize microservices, write Helm charts, deploy scalable clusters on Kubernetes, and build automated multi-environment CI/CD deployment pipelines.

title: Robotics & Autonomous Drones Aerial Arena
description: Speed racing and autonomous obstacle navigation showcase where collegiate quadcopters and automated rovers navigate dynamic lidar-scanned obstacle courses.

title: Inter-Branch Football Super League 2026
description: 7-a-side high-energy league tournament between university engineering departments featuring league matches, semifinals, and the under-the-floodlights grand finale.

title: E-Cell Venture Spark: Startup Pitch Deck Summit
description: Student entrepreneurs pitch disruptive technology solutions to angel investors and venture capital partners for seed funding and incubation support.

title: UI/UX Design Sprint & Figma Design Systems
description: A sprint workshop centered on modern design tokens, auto-layout 5.0, user research methods, interactive micro-interactions, and responsive design systems in Figma.

title: Tarang: Classical & Folk Fusion Music Evening
description: An enchanting musical evening celebrating classical ragas, contemporary acoustic fusion, and regional folk instruments presented by gifted student vocalists and instrumentalists.

title: Annual Badminton Singles & Doubles Tournament
description: Intense knockout tournament featuring men's and women's singles and mixed doubles badminton matches played under BWF international standard court regulations.

title: Blockchain & Smart Contract Security Audit Clinic
description: In-depth clinic focused on identifying reentrancy attacks, flash loan attack vectors, gas optimization patterns, and writing automated test suites using Foundry and Hardhat.
